# BM Classes

> IIT JEE and NEET coaching in Sector 45, Gurugram (Haryana, India). Every class is taught by former HODs of FIITJEE and VMC, in batches capped at 10–15 students. Listed on Google Maps as "Chemistry By Bighnaraj Sir" (rated 4.9 from 65 reviews).

## Key facts

- Address: Flat no 303, Ayyachi Apartment, Block C, Uday Nagar, Sector 45, near Delhi Public School, Gurugram, Haryana 122003
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98998 18241
- Website: https://www.bm-classes.com
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=5853186131892736630
- Batch size: 10–15 students maximum
- Modes: every crash course is hybrid (online + offline); 1-on-1 Science is online
- Centres listed on course posters: 303 Ayyachi Apartment (Sector 45), OD-55 Malibu Towne, 2423 Sector 46
- Results: JEE Advanced AIR 18, AIR 22, AIR 52; JEE Main 99+ percentile
- Free demo class: available, booked online and confirmed on WhatsApp

## Faculty

- Bighnaraj Mishra (BM Sir): Head of Chemistry, 20+ years; former Academic Head at VMC Gurgaon; former faculty at FIITJEE Kalu Sarai
- Konika Ma'am: Head of Biology, 20 years; taught the FIITJEE KVPY batch; former faculty at DPS Sushant Lok
- Chumki Ma'am: Science Lead, 22 years (18 years as senior faculty at FIITJEE); teaches Classes 9–12 online and 1-on-1

## Courses (2026–27)

- 12th Board 2027 Chemistry crash course: 35 hours of classes, 20 mock papers, board-focused, starts 10 October 2026
- 12th Board 2027 Biology crash course: 35 hours of classes, 20 mock papers, board-focused, starts 10 October 2026
- JEE Main 2027 Chemistry crash course: 40 hours of classes, 20 JEE Main mock papers, starts 10 November 2026
- NEET 2027 Chemistry crash course: 40 hours of classes, 20 NEET mock papers, starts 10 November 2026
- Class 10 Science & Maths rapid course completion: 70 hours Science + 70 hours Maths, 5 part tests + 10 full tests, 4 months till the board exams, starts 10 October 2026
- 1-on-1 Science with Chumki Ma'am: online, Classes 9–12, start anytime
